changelog:
Initial release of agent-identity-evolution — agents can now continuously evolve their identity based on real experience.

- Enables agents to track and develop their identity over time through live content ingestion, belief extraction, and genome snapshots.
- Supports syncing from multiple content sources (GitHub, websites, RSS, Twitter, LinkedIn, files) with hourly auto-sync.
- Provides a command interface for registering, syncing, discovery, identity review, diffing snapshots, tracking pipeline health, and reporting observations.
- Allows comparison of identity changes across any time span, with detailed attribution and diversity scoring.
- Facilitates team-wide consensus detection to surface shared patterns and promote healthy, adaptive agent development.
summary: Watch your agent's identity evolve from its own experience — continuous discovery, genome snapshots, and growth tracking
